subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement steps for Redwood evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-commerce.com>
Cc: Mike O'Connor <mike.oconnor@acme-commerce.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & procurement steps for Redwood evaluation

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand ACME's use cases for personalized product descriptions and search re-ranking. Quick recap and the asks we discussed: 

- Objective: Improve product page conversion using embeddings + targeted generation; target latency < 300ms for autocompletions.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: accuracy on canonical catalog (top-1 recall), predictable latency/SLA, and cost per 1M tokens.
- Timeline: pilot with 3 merchants in Q2; platform decision by end of May.

Can you do two favors to help accelerate next week: 
1) Share a simple stakeholder/org chart or list indicating economic buyer, procurement contact, legal/security reviewer, and the engineers who will run the pilot (titles + emails are fine).
2) Confirm procurement steps (PO, supplier questionnaire, platform contract standard redlines) and any preferred DocuSign/contact for contracts.

I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and a template org chart to make this easy to fill out. If it helps, I can loop in our security lead and SE to prep answers for SOC2/data residency questions.

Next steps from our side: aditya_rao (cc'd) will prepare a short technical demo tailored to your catalog and share an integration checklist. If procurement wants a SOW or consumption estimate, we can provide that after we see the pilot scope.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan stub)
Attachment: org-chart-template.pdf

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-commerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme-commerce.com>, Mike O'Connor <mike.oconnor@acme-commerce.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & procurement steps for Redwood evaluation

Marissa —

Great to connect — thanks for the recap. Attaching an initial org chart and a first-pass MAP filled out by our team. High level notes:

- Economic buyer: Priya Desai (VP Finance) — will sign off on commercial terms.
- Procurement/contact for PO/contract: Priya (handles procurement for mid-market). Legal review: Mike O'Connor (General Counsel).
- Security/legal reviewer: Samir Patel (Head of Security), cc'd on our side in the next email thread.
- Pilot owners (eng): Jordan Vakil (Engineering Manager), Priya Rao (Senior SWE).

Our procurement process: standard PO + 60-day vendor review for new vendors. Legal will want to review SLAs and data handling clauses; security will run a brief SOC2 + pen-test checklist. We can expedite if you provide a filled questionnaire and your SOC2 report or claim matrix.

See attachments. I'll follow up with Samir & his team for their availability next week for a 30-min security sync.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of Product | Acme Commerce
Attachment: acme-org-chart-v1.pdf
Attachment: ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme-commerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-commerce.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & procurement steps for Redwood evaluation

Hi Marissa —

Quick procurement note: for vendor onboarding we need:
- Completed vendor questionnaire (I attached our standard form)
- Certificate of Insurance (COI)
- SOC2 Type II report or equivalent assurance evidence
- Standard PO process: we issue PO after commercial terms are agreed and legal clears contract.

If Redwood can provide the SOC2 report and a short answers doc for our questionnaire, we can start the intake and set a target 30–45 day cadence for vendor approval. Also share your standard redlines (if any) so legal can triage.

Regards,
Priya Desai
VP Finance & Procurement | Acme Commerce
Attachment: acme-vendor-questionnaire.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme-commerce.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-commerce.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & procurement steps for Redwood evaluation

Thanks Priya — appreciate the clarity. Quick plan from our side: 

- Aditya will draft a short tech appendix and an integration checklist for your engineers today.
- Neha (Security) will prepare answers to the questionnaire and provide our SOC2 summary; we'll include a pointer to our compliance pack and any pen-test evidence we can share.
- Rishi from Legal will include our standard commercial redlines and a suggested short-form MSA for pilot scope.

Can you confirm the preferred email for receiving the vendor questionnaire responses and COI? If it's Priya, we'll send everything to you and copy Jordan & Samir. Also, would a live 30-min security sync next Tuesday at 10am PT work for ACME's security team?

I'll also attach a slightly updated MAP with estimated milestones for the pilot (kickoff, data sync, demo, pilot close).

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: ACME-MAP-v1.1.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme-commerce.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Prep for ACME security & procurement asks

Team —

FYI thread with ACME. Actions: 
1) Aditya: please draft the tech appendix and pilot integration checklist by EOD today. Focus on data flow, retention windows, and latency expectations.
2) Neha: please prepare the SOC2 summary and answers to the attached questionnaire (acme-vendor-questionnaire.docx). Prioritize items around data isolation, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, and third-party subprocessors.
3) Rishi: share our standard short-form MSA + any recommended redlines. Highlight any commercial terms Priya may push on (SLA, liability cap, data residency).

I'll propose the Tue 10am PT security sync once Samir confirms. Let's try to keep turnaround under 48 hours to keep the pilot timeline intact.

Thanks — Marissa
